arcs.name: Peco and Smile
arcs.summary: Childhood friends Peco and the emotionless Smile play table tennis at Katase High, where Peco is the star and Smile hides his talent.
events: Peco is easily beaten by Kong Wenge, a Chinese player who failed to make his national team.
Coach Koizumi pushes Smile to play seriously.

arcs.name: First Inter-High Preliminaries
arcs.summary: The Inter-High preliminaries bring the friends up against Kong, Kaio Academy and its ace Dragon.
events: Smile holds back and loses to Kong.
Peco is beaten by his old friend Akuma, and Dragon wins the tournament.

arcs.name: Falling and Rising
arcs.summary: After the tournament, the friends' paths split as Peco quits and Smile grows colder and stronger.
events: Peco quits table tennis while Akuma is expelled from Kaio after an assault.
Akuma urges Peco to return, and Peco trains with veteran Obaba.
Smile rises in reputation under Koizumi's coaching.

arcs.name: Second Inter-High
arcs.summary: A year later, the Inter-High preliminaries bring Peco back as a new hero.
events: Peco defeats Kong, who stays in Japan.
Peco plays through a knee injury and defeats Dragon.
Peco and Smile face each other in the final, and years later their careers have diverged.

filler.note: No filler: the series adapts the complete manga.
